handoff.salientSummary: Fixed all 8 foh-core UT round-1 backend/engine defects (expired holds, per-step oracle, location-scoped DELETE aliases, block UI payload, seat-with-tableIds, day-feed filters/counters/moveNotices/conflicts, withSetupWrite org-id lock key + rollback). Tests added for each; typecheck and oxlint clean; reservations/tenant-db/tenant-api suites pass (one pre-existing flaky timing test aside); verified live on tenant-api 3007 with curl and sqlite3.
handoff.whatWasImplemented: (1) Engine: `packages/reservations/src/engine/availability.ts` drops `existingHolds` with expiresAt<=now; `assign.ts` has `expiresAt` on AssignBookingRecord and skips expired holds in the `kind==='hold'` branch. (2) `src/testing/arbitraries.ts` `executeOperationSequence` now probes the brute-force oracle after every step; `engine.property.test.ts` asserts zero mismatches per step. (3) `operator-reservations-setup.ts`: `/locations/:locationId/{pacing,pacing-rules}/:id` and `/locations/:locationId/service-availability/:id` PUT/PATCH/DELETE aliases with `assertRowInRequestedLocation` (404 for other location); legacy routes kept. (4) `rsv-setup-crud.ts` createBlockForLocation uses `localToInstant().instantMs`; block handler accepts `date` as alias of `businessDate`. (5) `transitionReservationStatus` honours tableIds/comboId/overbook on seated (also from arrived), reusing assignReservationTables in the same tx; 409 rolls back. (6/7) `rsv-day-feed-service.ts` + `/book/day`: serviceId/areaId/source/tag filters, `counters {parties, covers}`, `filters`, per-query ETag suffix `.f<hash>` (unfiltered ETag unchanged), `moveNotices` (auto_reassigned events: reservationId, confirmationCode, guestName, partySize, localStartMin, hhmm, fromTableIds/Labels, toTableIds/Labels, reason, at) and `conflicts` with `kind:'blocked_table'` (locked bookings included) / `table_overlap`. (8) `packages/tenant-db/src/resolver.ts` WeakMap registry `getTenantDbOrgId`; `withSetupWrite` locks on the real org id (throws if unresolved) instead of 'setup'.

discoveredIssues.description: packages/reservations/src/engine/scale.test.ts asserts '< 50ms per day' and is flaky under load (86ms observed once; fails on clean baseline too).
discoveredIssues.suggestedFix: Loosen the threshold or measure a median of several runs.

discoveredIssues.description: Task paths were stale: engine files live at packages/reservations/src/engine/{availability,assign}.ts and the operation-sequence property test lives in packages/reservations (src/testing/arbitraries.ts + src/engine/engine.property.test.ts), not apps/tenant-api. Also resolveServiceForTime falls back to services[0], so a booking's stored serviceId can differ from the service whose window contains its time; the serviceId day filter matches on the stored serviceId first.
discoveredIssues.suggestedFix: UI-fix feature should read the day feed keys `counters`, `moveNotices`, `conflicts` (kind 'blocked_table' with reservationId, tableIds, blockId, message), and `filters` as added here.
